title: nous_ v2: calibrated candidate + evidence-density layer under a System-One decision model
supersedes: config.PreReg v1 gates (delta2 top-1 vs cosine/static/filesystem, E0/E1, C2 recon, grounding drift); retired 2026-09-29, see prereg/deviations.md
workflow: draft -> set status 'frozen' -> python -m manifold_mvp.prereg freeze prereg/plan_v2.json -> commit plan + lock together -> confirmatory scripts call manifold_mvp.prereg.require_confirmatory(). Any later edit is a deviation: log it in prereg/deviations.md and re-freeze with --force.

datasets.note: LoCoMo (snap-research, CC BY-NC 4.0; not committed). Categories: 1 multi-hop, 2 temporal, 3 open-domain, 4 single-hop, 5 adversarial. locomo_conv = the same 10 conversations re-voiced by the asking speaker: implicit style = qa[].implicit_query (+ implicit_subject_speaker) in locomo10_dialog.json; composed style = composed_query over gold_dia_ids (+ subject_speaker) in locomo10_multimem_full.json. Conversation ids index the sample order of data/locomo10.json (0 = conv-26 ... 9 = conv-50), identical in locomo10_dialog.json and in multimem sample_idx.

splits.note: 5-fold leave-conversations-out for development; confirmatory run on held-out conversations after freeze
splits.confirmatory_protocol: after freeze every fitted component (LOCATE head, adapters, temperature, Platt, abstention threshold) is refit per fold on that fold's 8 training conversations with the hyper-parameters frozen here and scored only on its 2 held-out conversations; out-of-fold predictions are pooled for the gate statistics (10 clusters).
splits.caveat: all 10 conversations were inspected in the 2026-09 reality check, so the confirmatory run tests frozen PROCEDURES on out-of-fold data, not unseen conversations; an external replication needs a new conversation source.

seeds.aggregation: per-question outcomes are averaged over the learned seeds before cluster statistics; per-seed estimates are reported; a contrast whose sign differs across seeds is INCONCLUSIVE whatever its averaged value.

statistics.sidedness: one-sided for superiority and non-inferiority; alpha is family-wise over holm_family
statistics.decision_bound: the LOWER of the cluster_t (df = n_clusters - 1) and cluster_bootstrap lower bounds: 10 clusters make the bootstrap alone anti-conservative
statistics.mcnemar_role: question-level exact test on paired binary outcomes; for a superiority claim on a binary metric it must also reject at the hypothesis' Holm level; it ignores clustering, so it is never sufficient alone; a learned arm enters it as the per-question majority over seeds (a tie counts as a miss)
statistics.adjusted_bound: Holm step-down on one-sided cluster_t p-values; the hypothesis with the j-th smallest p gets its lower bound at level alpha/(m-j+1), a non-rejected one at alpha/m.
statistics.verdicts: PASS = every pass criterion holds; INCONCLUSIVE = the point estimates meet the thresholds but a bound does not; FAIL otherwise. Kill criteria bind on FAIL; INCONCLUSIVE supports no claim and triggers no kill.
statistics.order: X0 must PASS before any other gate is evaluated; R1 filters System-One arms before they serve as baselines; exploratory gates are reported without multiplicity correction and never promoted to confirmatory claims.

arm_glossary.bm25: rank_bm25 Okapi over verbatim speaker-prefixed turns, per-conversation scope
arm_glossary.dense:<encoder>: cosine over normalized sentence-transformer embeddings, per-conversation scope
arm_glossary.fusion: L1: reciprocal-rank fusion (k = 60) of bm25 and dense:bge-base-en-v1.5
arm_glossary.fusion+contiguity: fusion shortlist expanded with same-session neighbouring turns, truncated to the same depth
arm_glossary.fusion+LOCATE: L2 density over the fusion+contiguity pool (top 100) U {null}; the top of the density is the shortlist
arm_glossary.reranker: cross-encoder/ms-marco-MiniLM-L-6-v2 over the top 30 of its input list

gates.hypothesis: The v2 harness reproduces the reality-check baseline ladder, so every v2 contrast is measured against the same baselines.
gates.metric: hit@1 (top-ranked turn is a gold evidence turn)
gates.kill: the harness does not reproduce: fix the harness before ANY other gate is evaluated (not a thesis kill)

gates.hypothesis: State identifiability: conditioning the query on the asking speaker's persona retrieves speaker-relative evidence ('when did I ...') that no state-free or trivially state-aware baseline trained on the same data retrieves.
gates.data: locomo_conv, implicit and composed styles, per-conversation scope
gates.metric: recall@10 on gold dia_ids (fraction of gold turns in the top 10), out-of-fold
arms: shuffled-state control (persona permuted across questions, trained identically)
speaker-name-prefix (non-learned: asking speaker's name prepended to the query)
gates.pass: for at least one encoder and for BOTH styles: mean(context-head - best comparator) >= +0.03 AND its Holm-adjusted cluster lower bound > 0; best comparator = the comparator arm with the highest pooled out-of-fold mean for that encoder x style
gates.kill: no encoder passes: drop state-conditioning as a thesis (the context head is archived as a negative result)

gates.hypothesis: First-stage multi-evidence recall: an evidence density over the candidate pool recovers ALL the turns a multi-hop question needs more often than fusion alone or fusion with contiguity expansion alone.
gates.metric: all-evidence recall@30 (1 iff every gold evidence turn is in the top 30, else 0)
gates.pass: multi-hop: mean(fusion+LOCATE - fusion) >= +0.05 AND mean(fusion+LOCATE - fusion+contiguity) >= +0.05, each with Holm-adjusted cluster lower bound > 0; overall (cats 1-4): non-inferior to fusion at margin 0.02 (Holm-adjusted lower bound of the difference > -0.02)
gates.kill: LOCATE is not a candidate-stage layer: L1 ships as fusion+contiguity, and LOCATE is kept only for what A1/C1 establish

gates.hypothesis: Pipeline: inserting LOCATE between fusion and the reranker costs nothing overall and helps multi-hop questions (retrieval level until an LLM reader is available).
gates.metric: hit@3 after reranking (any gold evidence turn in the top 3)
gates.pass: overall: Holm-adjusted lower bound of mean(LOCATE arm - fusion arm) > -0.02 (non-inferior); multi-hop: Holm-adjusted lower bound of the difference > 0 (superior)
gates.kill: LOCATE is removed from the reranking path; an answer-level re-test with an LLM reader is a NEW pre-registration, not a rescue of this one

gates.hypothesis: Abstention: the null slot of the LOCATE density flags adversarial / unanswerable questions (LoCoMo category 5) without abstaining on answerable ones.
gates.metric: AUROC of the null-slot mass for category 5 vs categories 1-4 (pooled out-of-fold); false abstention = fraction of category 1-4 questions whose null mass is >= tau
gates.pass: AUROC >= 0.70 AND Holm-adjusted cluster lower bound > 0.60 AND false abstention on categories 1-4 <= 0.10 at tau frozen per fold on its calibration (training) conversations
gates.kill: the null slot is not an abstention signal: drop it from LOCATE; abstention is left to DECIDE / the System-Two reader
gates.operationalization: tau = the threshold maximizing Youden's J on the fold's training conversations; the AUROC cluster bound resamples conversations and recomputes the pooled AUROC (cluster_t runs on per-conversation AUROCs).

gates.hypothesis: Calibration: with a temperature fitted on other conversations, the LOCATE top-1 probability is calibrated within every category.
gates.metric: top-1 ECE (15 equal-width bins, manifold_mvp.stats.ece) per category per held-out fold; calibration slope = logistic-regression slope of top-1 correctness on logit(top-1 confidence), pooled out-of-fold
arms: fusion+LOCATE, temperature fitted on the fold's training conversations
gates.pass: ECE <= 0.06 for every category on every held-out fold AND calibration slope in [0.8, 1.25]
gates.kill: LOCATE scores are not exposed as probabilities; System One / Two consume DECIDE's cross-fitted Platt scores instead
gates.operationalization: a category x fold cell with n < min_cell_n (open-domain has 96 questions in all) is pooled across folds for that category, still out-of-fold. A threshold on every fold, not a p-value: outside holm_family.

gates.hypothesis: Typed-decision validity: a System-One arm is a stable, calibrated measurement before it may serve as a baseline or a DECIDE arm.
gates.data: locomo, categories 1-4, candidate lists from fusion
gates.metric: repeat flip rate (same input twice), option-name effect (change in positive rate when option labels are renamed or reordered, percentage points), top-1 ECE after cross-fitted Platt
gates.pass: flip rate <= 0.02 AND option-name effect <= 3 points AND post-Platt ECE <= 0.05
gates.kill: the arm is excluded from best-baseline and from DECIDE

gates.hypothesis: Graph-geodesic bridging: shortest paths on a turn graph under a LEARNED metric reach multi-hop evidence that the same graph under an identity, whitening or random metric does not.
gates.metric: recall@10 (fraction of gold evidence turns in the top 10)
gates.pass: mean(learned - identity) >= +0.03 AND mean(learned - random) >= +0.03; whitening is reported, and a gain whitening matches is attributed to whitening, not to learning
gates.kill: archive all Riemannian code as a negative result

gates.hypothesis: C2 signature keys: path-signature keys index procedures better than order-agnostic or recurrent keys.
gates.data: procedural trajectories (SkillEvolBench / Mind2Web; not yet in data/)
gates.metric: top-1 retrieval of the matching procedure
gates.pass: mean(signature - best of mean-pooled / GRU / linear-CDE) >= +0.05 top-1

gates.hypothesis: Encoder upgrade without re-embedding: an orthogonal Procrustes adapter maps new-encoder queries into the old index's space.
gates.data: locomo, categories 1-4, dense only, per-conversation scope; adapter fit on the training conversations' turns (paired old/new embeddings of the same text)
gates.metric: recall@10 (fraction of gold evidence turns in the top 10), out-of-fold
arms: old->old: all-MiniLM-L6-v2 queries on the all-MiniLM-L6-v2 index
procrustes: bge-small-en-v1.5 queries rotated onto the all-MiniLM-L6-v2 index (both 384-d)
gates.kill: no adapter path: an encoder upgrade requires re-embedding the store
